source.value: Rippers Unmasked — The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Vital Sacrifice)

summary.value: You command your Phantasms to heal your allies.

system.description: You command your Phantasms to heal your allies. Each Phantasm runs towards a companion and shatters itself in a cloud of healing energy. Each target recovers 20 HP. A single ally cannot be healed by more than one Phantasm per action.
